meaning:
Νῶε
(as LXX, FlJ, who also gives Νώεος, Νῶχος), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. נֹחַ)

renderings.kjv: which was the son of Noe

elsewhere.note: “As the days of Noah were, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.
the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,
By faith, Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the…
who before were disobedient, when God waited patiently in the days of Noah, while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved…
and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly;
